# Nyte Support

## Documentation

Start with the repository's README and available
documentation before requesting support.

## Reporting Bugs

Search existing issues to avoid duplicate reports.

If the problem has not been reported, create a new issue
using the Bug Report template.

Include reproduction steps, expected behavior, relevant
versions, and sanitized logs when available.

## Feature Requests

Use the Feature Request template to suggest new
functionality or improvements.

Describe the problem and proposed solution.

## Documentation Issues

Use the Documentation template to report missing,
outdated, or unclear documentation.

## Development Tasks

Use the Task template to track maintenance and
implementation work.

## Security Vulnerabilities

Do not report security vulnerabilities through public issues.

Follow SECURITY.md for private reporting instructions.

## Response Times

Nyte is maintained as an open-source project.
Response times may vary depending on maintainer availability.
